categories.main_business_segments: CSMall Group Limited primarily operates in the New Jewellery Retail business, focusing on the design and sales of gold, silver, colored gemstones, gem-set and other jewellery products in the PRC. The Group previously operated a Fresh Food Retail segment involving online and offline sales of fresh food and related SaaS services, but this segment was discontinued in 2024.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group emphasizes product design, research and development, and production in jewellery, including lab-grown diamonds under the SISI brand. It leverages online marketing technologies such as short video marketing, e-commerce live streaming, and online celebrity promotion to enhance sales. The Group also engages in mineral exploration technologies for gold and antimony mining in Tibet.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group serves retail consumers and wholesale customers in the jewellery market in the PRC, with sales through online platforms and franchised shops. Its customers include end consumers purchasing gold and silver jewellery products, as well as wholesale clients via the Shenzhen Exhibition Hall. The Fresh Food Retail segment targeted enterprises along the agricultural supply chain and small to medium businesses before its disposal.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's operations are primarily located in the People's Republic of China, with offline retail presence in provinces including Beijing, Heilongjiang, Henan, Tibet, and Xinjiang. It also maintains a principal place of business in Hong Kong and a headquarters in Shenzhen, Guangdong. The mineral exploration business is focused on the Lhoka region in Tibet.
categories.supply_chain_position: CSMall Group Limited operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the jewellery supply chain, focusing on product design, retail sales, and wholesale distribution. Recently, it has strategically expanded upstream into gold resource exploration and mining through acquisition of exploration rights in Tibet, aiming to become a gold resource enterprise.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group's strategic focus includes shifting sales emphasis from gold to higher-margin silver products, enhancing online sales channels, and leveraging digital marketing innovations such as live streaming. It is investing in upstream gold exploration and mining to capitalize on the gold bull market. The Group also evaluates lab-grown diamond market potential cautiously and pursues cost control and business restructuring to improve profitability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of jewellery products including gold, silver, colored gemstones, and gem-set items via online platforms and franchised offline stores. The Group also derives income from wholesale sales through its Shenzhen Exhibition Hall. Previously, revenue included sales and SaaS services from the Fresh Food Retail segment, which has been discontinued.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group operates in the competitive PRC jewellery market, facing pressure from traditional gold jewellery companies and emerging niche segments. It positions itself by focusing on product differentiation, especially in silver products and culturally themed gold items. Its upstream mining exploration positions it to compete in the gold resource sector, although specific competitors are not named.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB157.6 million from continuing operations, down 61.6% from RMB410.5 million in 2023, mainly due to reduced gold product sales. Despite lower revenue, gross profit increased by 31.1% with gross margin improving to 30.7%. The Group returned to profitability with a net profit of RMB3.7 million from continuing operations, reversing a prior loss. Total assets stood at approximately RMB1.58 billion with net gearing ratio indicating a net cash position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CSMall Group Limited emphasizes high-margin silver jewellery products and culturally distinctive gold items to differentiate itself in a challenging market. It leverages innovative online marketing strategies including live streaming and influencer promotion to enhance brand awareness and sales. The Group's strategic move into upstream gold exploration aims to create long-term value by integrating resource ownership with retail operations, positioning it uniquely in the gold market.
